sources.dataset: Forebears — country-specific Most Common Last Names (2014 estimates)
sources.coverage: 1000 source rows; 1000 unique NFC Latin-script surnames retained after punctuation/diacritic equivalence checks. Research-only partial pool (target 3000).
sources.limitations: Cameroon-only country table; excludes generic Africa or neighboring-country surname inventories. Estimated national surname incidence only; individual legal-register attestation and source redistribution rights are not independently established. Source ranks and frequencies never used for sampling.

sources.dataset: ProceduralTextGeneration — source-order transcription of country-specific Forebears surname table
sources.temporal_scope: GitHub source snapshot available by 2023, nominal Forebears 2014 estimated ranking
sources.coverage: 1000 observed rows; original initial 500 values preserved byte-for-byte and in original order.
sources.limitations: Unofficial mirror; licence not published, redistribution rights to be reviewed before production. Source ends at approximately rank 1000; other ethnonymic or pan-African lists were not treated as national residence evidence.

sources.dataset: EveryPolitician — Cameroon Assembly and Senate nominative records
sources.geographical_scope: Cameroon only; National Assembly and Senate
sources.temporal_scope: Historical parliamentary snapshots; not a population census
sources.coverage: 458 new first-surname tokens from Assembly; 30 from Senate. Source blob SHA: Assembly 0e2f943fee6204244d6baf428b6a52c682ae6fb0; Senate c65e834d6883bbb56f05fafa3d9ac703d238928a
sources.limitations: First-token surname inference only where source records begin with uppercase; some patronymic/forename-order ambiguity remains; not population representative; redistribution rights require assessment

sources.dataset: Kingdoms in Africa / villages.cm — Noms de famille
sources.geographical_scope: Cameroon-specific surname directory, not an undifferentiated Africa list
sources.temporal_scope: Online directory, publication and collection years not specified
sources.coverage: 12 source-listed additional surnames, all retained verbatim
sources.limitations: No verified publisher count, nationwide coverage or reuse licence. Some other directory records show mojibake; selected entries avoid corrupted spellings. Independent civil-register attestation pending
